scope: Retain nonempty predeclared descriptions on mandatory DXF canonical LTYPE rows and carry them through dwg2dxf.
finding: A generated canonical callback with a custom description previously succeeded while the fixed row used a built-in description.
change: Emit predeclared descriptions, including empty, through UTF-8-aware DXF writing; the dwg2dxf adapter copies source descriptions into the predeclared metadata. Nondefault callback descriptions without matching predeclaration refuse atomically; default callbacks leave the predeclared description authoritative.
checks: Generated BYBLOCK, BYLAYER and CONTINUOUS tests pass for AC1009, AC1014 and AC1032 in ASCII and Binary, including a non-ASCII description.
Unseeded and conflicting custom descriptions refuse without replacing the destination; a corrected same-writer retry matches expected output.
The dwg2dxf adapter test writes and reads CONTINUOUS flags and nonempty description in all six version/encoding combinations without mutating the input.
Focused CTests libdxfrw_ltype_table_allocation, libdxfrw_appid_table_allocation and libdxfrw_dxf_source_table_identities pass 3/3.
Relinked LibreCAD system-codec tests pass the LTYPE selection (17 cases and 4135 assertions, one ODA-fixture case skipped) and PR #3269 selection (5 cases, 49 assertions).

Predeclared empty descriptions survive fresh readback for all three canonical names and all six version/encoding combinations; the dwg2dxf adapter also round-trips empty CONTINUOUS descriptions in six combinations.
limitations: An unseeded empty CONTINUOUS callback means the built-in Solid line description. Callers requiring explicitly empty output must predeclare a source row. A predeclared metadata-only row with empty description now emits empty rather than the former built-in description.
The LibreCAD checks reused compiled consumer objects; this was not a clean consumer rebuild.
Generated readback does not prove independent producer semantics or whole-document support.
